name: clean-proven-behavior-change
rule: clean control: behavior change with a test and pasted output
message: reject negative prices in the pricing route
body:
## Intent

A negative price made the discount route return a nonsense percentage.

## Changed / not changed

- Changed: the route rejects a negative price with 400.
- Not changed: the discount maths.

## Risks

None.

## Verified

The new test `discountRoute rejects a negative price with 400` fails without the change and passes with it:

```
$ pnpm vitest run src/server/routes/pricing.test.ts
 ✓ discountRoute rejects a non-numeric price with 400
 ✓ discountRoute rejects a negative price with 400
 Tests  2 passed (2)
```
